title: Nylas calendar.created notification object
description: Sent when a user creates a calendar. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

grant_id.description: Unique identifier for the grant that owns this calendar.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs of custom metadata attached to the calendar.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the user's primary calendar.

location.description: Geographic location associated with the calendar.

read_only.description: Whether the calendar is read-only for the authenticated user.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the calendar (e.g. America/New_York).

is_owned_by_user.description: Whether the authenticated user owns this calendar.

owner_email.description: Email address of the account that owns the calendar. Microsoft grants only; omitted for other providers.

hex_color.description: Background color of the calendar in hex format. May be omitted if not set by the provider.

hex_foreground_color.description: Foreground (text) color of the calendar in hex format. May be omitted if not set by the provider.
